qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers shift lever removal and installation procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 25 - Gear Shift Mechanism covers shift lever removal and installation procedures.

qa_pairs.question: What page number shows the procedure for replacing the shift lever dust cover?
qa_pairs.answer: The shift lever dust cover replacement procedure is on page 25-8.

qa_pairs.question: Which transmission types have separate shift layout drawings in this section?
qa_pairs.answer: There are separate shift layout drawings for manual transmission and automatic transmission.

qa_pairs.question: What page covers the selector lever complete with base removal and installation for automatic transmission?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 25-15 covers the selector lever complete with base removal and installation for automatic transmission.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two types of shift consoles mentioned for manual transmission procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: The two types of shift consoles mentioned are sheet metal shift console and aluminum shift console.

qa_pairs.question: On which page can you find information about adjusting the cable for range selector lever?
qa_pairs.answer: Information about adjusting the cable for range selector lever can be found on page 25-22.
